notes.title: JRoguePG Demo is now available!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305396/86ea4ff5be42d8e80f375f157d804fa427f22533.jpg"][/img]We are still a few months out from a full release, but the JRoguePG demo is now available![/p][p]-Play the first two stages of the game including 11 different biomes.[/p][p]-Unlock and play as most of the playable classes.[/p][p]-Get a head start on growing your power by earning permanent buffs in preparation for the full game because your save file will carry over![/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist the full game now! [/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2996020/JRoguePG/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p]Note: There is some placeholder art for the different class face portraits. My artist Pseph is finishing them up as I post t his! :-) @psephrain8[/p]

notes.title: The Closed Beta is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45305396/8c007e7f4cc68cef3a3463b0db7304734edc7f16.jpg[/img]

JRoguePG is nearly complete and I am looking for volunteers to play it early and collaborate with other gamers to help make it as good as it can be before the official release.

Interested? Fill out this quick survey here: [url=https://forms.gle/7bUbxQ7r316ehanw7]https://forms.gle/7bUbxQ7r316ehanw7[/url]

You will be notified via email whether you are accepted into the beta test or not. You will be given access to the game the evening of Friday 4/25/25 to start testing. All communication regarding the closed beta must be kept to a Steam group chat that will be provided if you are accepted into the private beta test. The beta test will last until June 1st.

Wishlist JRoguePG now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2996020/JRoguePG/

I'm excited to begin and finally let you play the game after a year of development.

Sincerely,
Andrew Ryan Henke

Note: Some legacy art is still visible in the store page and for some of the character portraits in game. [u][b]There will be absolutely no AI modified or generated art in the final store page and product.[/b][/u] I have hired the talented Persephone Rain @psephrain8 to do all of the character art which should all be completed late June.
